articleBlocks: Pinpoint #670 connects File folder, Guitar music, Drink can, Spreadsheet, and Web browser through one shared feature: tabs. The clues deliberately mix physical objects, music notation, containers, office software, and browsing habits, so any single-domain answer feels too narrow. That spread is the point: each clue uses tabs in a different setting, which makes the category broad but still exact without collapsing into only browser behavior.

A file folder can have a tab label. Guitar music can be written as tabs, short for tablature. A drink can has a pull tab. A spreadsheet has sheet tabs, and a web browser can have too many open tabs. Once the browser clue lands, the same word checks every earlier clue.
The answer is Things with tabs. It is broader than office supplies or digital tools because the clue set includes a can and guitar music as well as folders, spreadsheets, and browsers.
The full board confirms one exact category: folder tabs, guitar tabs, pull tabs, spreadsheet tabs, and browser tabs.
